title: Go close-out opens the epic PR without the review verdict or findings; forge cannot post them
body: The epic DoD requires the final review's verdict and every finding on the PR. internal/reconcile/closeout.go:172-176 opens the PR with a fixed 'PR + CI rule' body, and internal/forge/forge.go offers only Find/Open/CI, with no comment or body update, so nothing carries the review-epic decision onto the PR. This is the host running epics today (distinct from 5c906cc7, which covers the TS port). A person merging sees CI status and not a NOT READY review.
